en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a historic city square with a richly decorated Renaissance/Baroque palace-like building and a tall clock tower with a spire. In the foreground stands an equestrian statue on a pedestal in the center of a round plaza with early 20th‑century buses and a streetlamp around it. The printed caption at the bottom reads "Dresden – Ehemaliger Schloßplatz."
